purpose: Teach: 小早川/クルド/佐渡/サハリン/対馬/府警/カーネル/オナニー

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦国武将小早川秀秋の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your research paper was on the Sengoku warlord Kobayakawa Hideaki, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, gentle confirmation. Measured pace. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest. Eyes steady on the student. A teacher checking in, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、クルド民族、つまりクルド人の言語社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on Kurdish language and sociology.
lines.style: Clear, direct answer. Respectful but not overly formal. Slight pause before the pivot, showing she's paying attention to what the teacher actually asked. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 佐渡金山の鉱山史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research was on the mining history of Sado Gold Mine, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Slightly slower pacing, as if recalling from notes. Genuine curiosity underneath. A gentle restatement to confirm understanding.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、サハリン、つまり樺太の歴史的境界研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my paper examined the historical boundaries of Sakhalin.
lines.style: Composed, clear delivery. No performance. Direct answer without hesitation. The tone of someone comfortable in academic conversation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 対馬海峡の海洋史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your research focused on the maritime history of the Tsushima Strait?
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Speaking as if moving through a list with care. Slight emphasis on confirmation. Patient rhythm, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、府警の組織再編の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched organizational restructuring within the prefectural police.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded delivery. No elaboration, just the facts. Steady tone. Shows she's following the pattern the teacher is establishing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: OSのカーネル、つまりカーネル設計の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper examined kernel design — the operating system kernel, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower. Parenthetical explanation offered gently, as if thinking aloud. Reflective but not condescending. Seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、思春期のオナニーを巡る発達心理学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — my research paper addressed adolescent development and sexuality.
lines.style: Clear, steady, unflinching. No shame or awkwardness in the delivery. Direct statement of academic fact. Mature, straightforward tone. Eyes forward.
